batches_completed.summary: api-contracts-server.md written: GATEWAY_PROTOCOL_VERSION 5.7.0, GCP6 6.0.0, 29 frozen capabilities, HTTP routes from app/gateway-application.mjs, 15 client->server / 22 server->client / 20 task events, zod schema catalog, auth model.
No state library; pure reducer in shared/gateway-client-state.mjs + 26 useState in App.jsx + ~20 refs in useRealtimeVoice.js. 6 components, 15 pure logic modules with matching tests.
Pairing shell that lazily imports web/src/App.jsx. One endpoint (POST /api/access/pair). HTTPS enforced twice. SecureStorage for token, Preferences for device id.

Main-process heavy; renderer is the web client via desktopOrbUrl. 33-member contextBridge IPC contract. contextIsolation+sandbox on all windows; backgroundThrottling:false required for playback receipts.
No database. VersionedJsonStore + JsonSnapshotStore base classes: atomic tmp+rename, 0600, corrupt-file quarantine, degrade-never-crash. 6 durable stores.

42 published exports reaching into every workspace; 72 env vars; auth middleware ordering at gateway-application.mjs:583-599 is the public/private boundary; 4 CI workflows; Chinese-as-i18n-key convention.
